notes.title: Update 11.3
notes.content:
Hey Kings and Queens!
Version 11.3 is here, bringing you the following:
New Jester Box Rune: Fool’s Pushback
The Jester Box has a chance to teleport the Hero 10 tiles back after exploding.
Unique Tier 6 effect: After exploding, the Jester Box applies Morale Stun to the Hero for 8 seconds.
Hero will gain Teleport Immunity for 8 seconds after being teleported by the Jester Box.

notes.title: Update 11.0
notes.content:
Hey Kings and Queens!
Version 11.0 is here, bringing you the following:
-Join in the birthday celebration with anniversary sale, extra pearl mines in conquest and other birthday discount events.
-New Throne Room Level. New Levels for almost everything! There will also be new Quests to complete.
-Don’t miss out on this year’s birthday costume! Brand new Jade Item Set for Pro and Uber category with various new perk combinations.
-Bug fixes and polishing.

notes.title: Our new Version 10.0.0
notes.content:
Hey Kings and Queens!

Version [b]10.0.0[/b] is here, bringing you the following:

[*]The launch of a second Server the [i]New Kingdom[/i]!
